mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% in a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the tightening signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month growth in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate revenues and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with positive RSAFS growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a month signals a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances despite the labor market weakening signal.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a contraction in supply, which leads to lower corporate output and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the supply contraction signal.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL), real interest rates are positive, which typically signals a tightening monetary policy and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the positive real interest rate signal.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) decline by more than 5% in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) increases by more than 0.3% in the same period, it signals a weakening demand environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST declines > 5% and UNRATE increases > 0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in > 70% of triggered instances despite the weakening demand signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 1% signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in > 40% of instances with positive PAYEMS growth.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) grows by less than 1% in a quarter and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in the same period, it signals stagflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 growth < 1% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in > 60% of triggered instances despite the stagflation signal.
